title: MPUV Cargo (Argo Astronautics, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The MPUV Cargo is a short-range cargo shuttle from Argo Astronautics in Star Citizen, flown by one pilot. A small cargo pod sits behind the cockpit. It has no weapons, so the trigger only works in the operator modes.

panels.name: MPUV Cargo: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the MPUV Cargo's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Unarmed
controls.text: The MPUV Cargo has no guns and no missiles.
controls.context: It is a work shuttle for moving goods between big ships and stations, not for fighting.

controls.name: Cargo (2 SCU)
controls.text: The pod holds 2 SCU of cargo. The goods travel in standard boxes.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.

panels.name: Right stick (flight stick)
panels.text: The right-hand stick steers the ship's nose and does the fighting: it fires the weapons, picks targets and holds the buttons for radar, quantum travel, scanning and mining.
panels.context: This is the game's own two-stick preset for the Thrustmaster T.16000M. Many buttons change their job with the operator mode shown on the HUD; the stick's base buttons 5 to 16 sit on the stick's foot.

controls.name: Trigger
controls.text: This ship has no pilot guns, so the trigger works only in the operator modes. In quantum mode, holding it starts the jump of the quantum drive.
controls.context: The destination is chosen on the star map first; in scanning or mining mode the trigger does that mode's job instead.
